method: Fifteen rigid cutouts; fixed-length arm and leg IK; pelvis drive leads hands; rear toe pivot; constant scale.
limitations: Planar cutout rig, not a 3D anatomical or dynamics simulation.
Projected joints are manually placed. Authored pelvis shift and heel lift, not force/center-of-mass simulation or footstep.
Clean torso/waist generated once; other cutouts reuse the original illustration.
Lighting baked before animation; rigid rotations do not recalculate material highlights.
Only a small planted-foot thrust; larger movements need additional views and occlusion art.
